draft.intro_short_en: See the blue-roofed Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall.
draft.intro_long_zh: 看中山纪念堂蓝瓦大屋顶与广场。先从广场看八角外形，再按开放安排看建筑内部。
draft.intro_long_en: See the blue-roofed Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall. Start in the square to see the octagonal outline and check indoor access if you wish to go inside.

draft.intro_short_en: See Guangzhou's illuminated riverfront from a night boat.

draft.intro_long_en: See Guangzhou's illuminated riverfront from a night boat. Compare routes before choosing a departure pier, since cruises cover different stretches of the river.
